family: Omron E2E standard cylindrical inductive proximity sensor (bed probe candidate E2E-X8MD1 2M)
title: OMRON E2E Standard Proximity Sensor data sheet, CSM_E2E_DS_E_12_4, 35 pages

which_part.picked_by: vendor_cad/staging/SOURCES.txt ('probe pick E2E-X8MD1 2M'); the data sheet covers the whole E2E family
which_part.decoded: E2E = cylindrical inductive; X8 = 8 mm sensing distance; M = unshielded; D1 = DC 2-wire, normally open, with polarity; 2M = 2 m pre-wired cable
which_part.is_not: an NPN or PNP three-wire sensor. It has two leads and switches in series with a load

E2E_X8MD.ref: p.7 (ordering), p.13 'E2E-X[]D[] DC 2-Wire Models' ratings, p.17 engineering data, p.20 I/O circuit, p.25-26 precautions, p.28 dimensions (Diagram 6)
E2E_X8MD.principle: inductive (high-frequency oscillation), detects ferrous metal; reduced distance on non-ferrous metal
E2E_X8MD.output: DC 2-wire, NO (D1) or NC (D2); load on either the +V or the 0 V side; brown +V, blue 0 V
E2E_X8MD.indicators: operation (red) and setting (green) on D1 models
E2E_X8MD.temperature_influence: +/-10 % of the sensing distance at 23 degC over -25 to 70 degC
E2E_X8MD.repeatability_note: not specified anywhere in the data sheet

dimensions_mm.unthreaded_sensing_head: 9 dia x 7 long, in front of the thread
dimensions_mm.nuts: two, 17 across flats, 21 over corners, 4 thick
dimensions_mm.cable: 4 dia vinyl, 2 conductors of 0.3 mm2 (insulator 1.3 dia), 2 m

material_curves_read_from_p17.how: 'Influence of Sensing Object Size and Material', chart E2E-X8MD[], REFERENCE values, target 1 mm thick, read by eye (+/-0.15 mm)
material_curves_read_from_p17.note: the aluminium curve is still falling at the largest plate shown (50 mm); a 220 mm, 6 mm thick bed is outside the chart

three_wire_alternatives_in_the_same_shee.ref: p.16 'E2E-X[]E[]/F[] DC 3-Wire Models', p.21 I/O circuit
three_wire_alternatives_in_the_same_shee.E2E-X5ME1: M12 unshielded, NPN NO, 5 mm +/-10 %, same housing drawing (Diagram 6)
three_wire_alternatives_in_the_same_shee.output_circuit: NPN transistor to 0 V with a 100 ohm series resistor and an internal constant-current source of 1.5 to 3 mA from +V to the output (black lead)

compared_with_printer_v6_stand_in.v6: designs/printer_v6.py bed_probe(): PL-08N-class box 18 x 18 x 36 with two M3 cross holes, NPN NO three-wire, 6-36 V, 8 mm on steel, 3.2 mm on aluminium +/-10 %, 70 degC, BAT85 diode in the signal lead
compared_with_printer_v6_stand_in.wiring: DIFFERENT: two-wire, not NPN three-wire. Residual voltage up to 3 V when on and 0.8 mA leakage when off; needs 3 mA minimum load
compared_with_printer_v6_stand_in.sensing_on_aluminium: about 2.8 mm on a 50 mm plate and falling (v6: 3.2)
compared_with_printer_v6_stand_in.shape: DIFFERENT: M12 threaded barrel 47 mm long with nuts, not a block with cross holes
compared_with_printer_v6_stand_in.supply: 10 to 30 V (v6 assumes 6-36 V; 24 V is inside both)
compared_with_printer_v6_stand_in.mass: about 70 g packed with 2 m of cable (v6: 20 g)
